file_to_url: strip output_dir prefix; strip trailing 'index.html' (root index.html -> '/'); 404.html has no route; ensure leading slash
second_source_of_truth: sitemap.xml <loc> count (emitted by default via the classic preset)
gotchas: Naive '*.html under build/' counts 28, overcounting by 1: 404.html is a flat file and an error page, not a route — the emitted sitemap correctly excludes it.
The build log reports no page count at all ('Generated static files in build' only), so the sitemap is the only built-in second source of truth.

Hand-counting source files undercounts badly: 4 blog source posts produce 15 blog URLs (blog index, /blog/archive, /blog/authors/*, /blog/tags/* per tag); category index pages (/docs/category/tutorial---basics/) are also generated, not sourced.

Category directory names are slug-encoded: docs/tutorial-basics/_category_.json with label 'tutorial/basics' becomes /docs/category/tutorial---basics/ (slash -> triple dash) — the file_to_url rule stays mechanical but the URL is not guessable from the source dir name.
Every route is emitted as <route>/index.html; the only flat html file in build/ is 404.html, so the foo.html vs foo/index.html distinction collapses to 'exclude 404.html'.
A new blog post tagged with a new tag would create an extra /blog/tags/<tag> page, making the +3 test overshoot — the test post/doc must reuse existing tags (or none).
create-docusaurus@latest now prompts interactively for language (JavaScript/TypeScript); non-interactive scaffolding requires passing --javascript or --typescript explicitly.
